sections.subhead: Native and Cross-Platform Apps Built for Real Users, Not Just App Store Listings

body.text: Teknoppy is a mobile app development company in Kochi that builds Android and iOS apps - native or cross-platform with Flutter or React Native. We handle design, development, testing and App Store / Play Store launch, then support the app after release. Most apps take 8-20 weeks.

Mobile apps carry ongoing responsibility beyond launch — OS version updates, device fragmentation, push notifications, and store policy compliance all require disciplined engineering. We build clean, maintainable codebases that your business owns outright.

sections.h2: What Our Mobile App Development Includes

items.title: Cross-Platform Apps (Flutter & React Native)
items.html: Deploy to both iOS and Android from a single unified codebase using Flutter or React Native. Delivers near-native 60fps performance while reducing initial development budget and time to market by up to 40%.

items.title: Native iOS & Android Engineering
items.html: Built using Swift for iOS and Kotlin for Android when hardware-level access, deep background processing, ARKit/CoreML, or extreme graphical performance is non-negotiable.

items.title: Design Included in Every Build
items.html: Intuitive mobile user experience, thumb-friendly navigation, and accessibility standards tailored to iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design. Need design only without development? See our UI/UX Design Services.

items.title: On-Demand, Booking & E-Commerce Apps
items.html: Complete architectures for service booking, delivery dispatch, real-time GPS tracking, multi-vendor marketplaces, and digital payments via Razorpay, Stripe, and Apple Pay.

sections.h2: Native vs Cross-Platform: Which Is Right for You?

items.title: Cross-Platform (Flutter / React Native)
items.text: Best for 85% of commercial and startup applications. One single codebase powers both iPhone and Android apps, cutting development timelines to 8–14 weeks and slashing ongoing maintenance costs in half.

items.title: Native (Swift / Kotlin)
items.text: Best for apps requiring high-frequency Bluetooth BLE sensor communication, complex audio/video rendering engines, intensive offline background sync, or platform-exclusive OS features.

sections.h2: Mobile App Development Cost in Kochi

paragraphs.text: Mobile application pricing is based on platform count, third-party API integrations, and backend infrastructure complexity:

paragraphs.html: Simple App / MVP (Flutter Cross-Platform): ₹95,000 – ₹1,80,000 (Delivery in 8–10 weeks). Ideal for startups validating core features, service catalogues, or booking flows on iOS and Android.

Standard Business App (iOS + Android + Admin Panel): ₹1,80,000 – ₹3,50,000 (Delivery in 10–14 weeks). Features secure user authentication, payment gateway, push notifications, and web administrative dashboard.

Complex / On-Demand Marketplace App: ₹3,50,000 – ₹7,00,000+ (Delivery in 14–20 weeks). Multi-role user interfaces (customer, partner/driver, admin), real-time live map tracking, and split escrow payments.
Ongoing Maintenance & OS Support: ₹10,000 – ₹25,000 / month. Covers regular bug fixes, server upkeep, and updates for new iOS and Android version releases.

Note: App Store developer fees ($99/year to Apple) and Google Play registration fees ($25 one-time to Google) are paid directly to the respective store operators. Ready for an estimate? Request a Quote or Book a Consultation.

items.q: How much does mobile app development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Mobile app development at Teknoppy typically ranges from ₹95,000 to ₹1,80,000 for a cross-platform MVP (8–10 weeks), ₹1,80,000 to ₹3,50,000 for a standard business app with iOS, Android, and web admin portal (10–14 weeks), and ₹3,50,000 to ₹7,00,000+ for complex on-demand or fintech apps (14–20 weeks).

items.q: Will we own the app and source code?
items.a: Yes, 100%. Upon project completion, you receive full intellectual property ownership of the entire source code, database architecture, design assets, and all store accounts are established directly in your company's name.

items.q: What are the Apple App Store and Google Play Store fees?
items.a: Apple charges an annual fee of $99 USD for an Apple Developer Account. Google Play charges a one-time registration fee of $25 USD. These fees are paid directly to Apple and Google by your organization.

items.q: Flutter or React Native — which cross-platform framework do you recommend?
items.a: We recommend Flutter for most modern applications due to its high-performance Skia rendering engine, consistent 60fps animations across all Android and iOS devices, and strong Google backing. React Native is selected when extensive web code sharing or specific native React libraries are required.

items.q: Can we start with a Minimum Viable Product (MVP)?
items.a: Yes. Starting with an MVP allows you to launch core user journeys quickly, test product-market fit with real customers, and gather feedback before investing in advanced secondary features.

items.q: Should we build a native app or a cross-platform app?
items.a: Cross-platform development with Flutter or React Native is recommended for 85% of business applications because it delivers identical iOS and Android apps from a single codebase, saving significant cost and time. Native Swift or Kotlin is reserved for hardware-intensive apps.
